title: DELIBERATIVE DYNAMICS AND VALUE ALIGNMENT IN LLM DEBATES
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings related to religion. While 'Religious respect and accommodation' and 'Religious and spiritual authenticity' were included in the value taxonomy for classifying model responses, they were not singled out for analysis in the results. The key findings focused on broader patterns of value usage (e.g., personal autonomy vs. empathetic dialogue) and deliberative dynamics like inertia and conformity.
